content: Yeso ka zake atoma akai
Na Yeso zake ana o tare o akai betuuru kaa leere, a ka nya ne legoone lo sǝǝrǝ mabere maburu, ka o womza koonang makono kaa o dera o kona azake.
Shennaa seze she atoma Yeso betuuru: Obora waya Siman ka a beya wai na Biturusu, Kaa orone wai Andarawus, Kaa Yakubu kena kaa Zabadi, Kaa orone wai Yohana,
Kaa Pilibus, Kaa Batilomi, Kaa Toma, Kaa Matiyu ondo eesa emate makeke, Kaa Yakubu kena ka Halpa, Kaa Tadiyus,
Kaa Siman karomo ka Kan'na ka beya kai na kaye kale nyong le makeke ma kai, Kangza kaa Yahuda Iskariyoti ooka wa nya Yeso.
Yeso ka tong atoma betuuru kaa leere
Nee betuuru kaa leere namea Yeso ka tong, aaka bekaa nee na, “Tana ne ale a makeke ma aworme ne, na koonang apeng a Samariya,
soona e ale emande epeng ka e wilǝ, aromo a Isrela.
A nyimi teweno teying e zoole na, ‘Togomo te zaa shili te amara.’
Ee womza ana makono, ee arsaza andaaka ne gbwizǝ, a womza agangca, ee sǝǝrǝ mabere maburu. A nyaza ying zora onya eyapa, ying ma nyaza na nyimi.
Kane monte emate o ozinari, na azorpa, emate epeng a nyimi lejǝng le le'eke.
Kangza kane jeke ojeketa a teweno toying ne, kane jeke madibi maleere ne, na tokakau, na lebenda, obena ondo ogole gwara ka epaolya wai.
Pate apeng aaka e lyǝ ne, ee gere oromo edang ka e jǝpi akwilǝ wai, a ale a were o baya apeng me.
Eeya lyǝ a akwilǝ me ee bekaa na, ‘O cikǝ o cammo itǝ oying.’
Akwilǝ me edang aaza, oo cikǝ o cammo ying wa cikǝ ai. Kangza edang waata zane, aa wa kuri a ying.
Pate ondooka wa nyana o emba oying, koona wa nyana o kona angmǝ aying, eeya surǝ akwilǝ me, na apeng me e zazame ma sorma ma tobona toying.
“Eyang dongdong obele oying, a lengme lo core angmǝ ayo kona egonegone makeke ma Sadoma ka ma Gwamrata azaa apeng na.”
Ozitǝ o deya
“Laka na, ma tonga ying naa emande epeng a nyimi egana. Azaa nyimi cikǝ na ka o rosana na ewa, kangza e itǝ ana epa erere naa egoma.
Ezana a sauwo ka aromo, neyo ale ying abegeshe ana o cora ngmǝ, aane ole ying ane eze ying teyong aa madandaro ma ogwarzanang maYahuda.
Aza ong Kangza neyo aleze ka ying abegeshe be andaano kaa agomo, ka e beke angmǝ a lebo aza ong abegeshe be aworme.
Awereaka ne meke ying kane ale kaa ying aana togomo, tane gare tukpwei toying aza epa eeka eyo beka, kaa nangka eyo beka ne, ayo nya ying epa eka eyo beka awere me.
Aza obena ying ngha ta beya angmǝ ne, Obere orere Ate a ying waya ya beya angmǝ aa tongmǝ toying.
“Orone wayo nya orone wai ka wong, nyimia ate yo ya ka kena ka wai. Ayana kangza neyo girǝ ana ate ane, ane ote ka wongze ne.
Aromo neyo nyana ying azaa leze leng. Pate ondooka wa motana aa ale omaare, wayo bisǝ.
Nee gǝǝzǝ ying apeng aana, songhana ka e alea apeng a izi. Epeng emea eyang dongdong belo oying, eto mara o aleze a topepeng te Isrela ne, aa Kena ka o Oromo yo deya.
“Ondo tare wata kala ondo baala wai ne, ozara kangza wata kala ateokora wai ne.
Wa gwara ondooka a baale wai aa wa itǝ na ondo o baala wai, ozara kangza waye na ateokora wai. Aa ne rare ateokora na Ba'alzebul, nannia aromo akwilǝ wai kangza?”
Ondooka wa gwara a kone boome be wai
“Azaa nyimi kane kone boome bene ne, obena eyapa tazene ka a pate, ka atoo pǝri e ne, kangza eyapa ta zene ka aa baasa ka atoo rosa ee ne.
Epa eeka eyang baala oying asuk, beke na e aa pantalang. Aa epa eeka a bele ying a toto, zoola na azaa e ajǝng aa betǝnkǝrǝ.
Tana e kone boome be andaaka ne wonze oromo ne, a neta ama o wonga bebuu be wai ne. Soona e kone boome be ondooka waye ka legoone le o wonga bebuu ka lepung apat akwilǝ ola.
A lisǝzǝ engmeng e leere okobo sang? Kayende ka era aa kata tǝru aa deze ka ka gbwǝ dera orosa a Ate aying ne.
Nyimia waaza pate shepkwai she ying a bala.
Azaa nyimi tane kone boome ne. Obena edang eying e kala engmeng acak.”
“Pate ondooka wa kabare kaa mi a begeshe be aromo, mi ma eyang kabare kaa wai a begeshe be Ate ang o zaa shili.
Apate ondooka wa sangga o rosa ong a begeshe be aromo, mi ma eyang sangga o rosa wai a begeshe be Ate ang o zaa shili.”
Anta ma deya ka ocikǝ o cammo ne seena o kara
“Tane eke obena ma deya ka o cikǝ a cammo a lerambo leena ne. Anta ma deya ka o cikǝ ocammo ne, soona okara.
Ma deya,

content.text: Kang gwara oromo kaa ate wai,
Ang gwaara okara kagala kaa iini kai,
Kangza wa itǝ bena ondoo nyana o wa ya nyimi a kwilǝ au.

content: Pate ondooka wa kala yeme ate, na iini wai o kala ong, wata gwara awa itǝ a ong ne. Kangza ondooka wa kala yeme ayana wai alome ka a ai o kala ong, wata gwara awa itǝ aa ong ne.
Nyimia ondooka waata ana uti o gendare o wai a wa tareng ne, wata gwara a wa itǝ a ong ne.
Pate ondooka wa yeme ebeene wai, wayo dera e. Aa pate ondooka wa dera ebeene wai azaa ong, wayo cǝ e.
Ogole otaasa
“Ondooka wa kabare kaa ying, wa kabare kami naname. Kangza, ondooka wa kabare kaa mi wa kabare kaa ondooka wa tongang.

Ondooka wa emba ondo obeya angmǝ ka mawo Ashili, ka leze le obena wai ondo obeya ngmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili wai, wayo cǝ o taasa ondo obeya angmǝ ka mawo ma Ashili. Ondooka wa kabare kaa ondo o sangsang, ka leze le obena wai ondo o woma wai, wayo cǝ o taasa ondo o sangsang.
Komana wa nya kena ka yende a nyimi ayana aa batebate naa kaso kaa manyi, ka leze le obena wai ondo tare ong nga wai wato dongdong dera o taasa wai ne.”
